title: Salon booking confirmed
description: Confirm a salon or spa booking with service, stylist and time. Booking confirmation WhatsApp template for beauty businesses.
notes: Add your cancellation policy window; it sets expectations and lowers no-shows.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, you're booked for a *{{service}}* with {{stylist}} at {{studio}} on {{date}} at {{time}}. Please arrive a few minutes early so we can start on time and make the most of your visit.
